entities.name: UniProt Q6Z382
observations: The 768-aa query sequence matches reviewed Oryza sativa coatomer subunit gamma-2 (Q6Z382) at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; reference coverage is 86.4%.

Reference annotation describes a COPI coatomer subunit involved in Golgi vesicle budding and retrograde Golgi-to-ER transport; localization includes cytoplasm, Golgi membrane, and COPI-coated vesicles.
Sequence-derived estimates: 85.6 kDa molecular mass and pI 5.05; Pfam Adaptin_N spans residues 28–541 and COP-gamma_platf spans 624–768.
